prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” HVAC company for everyone in Houston — the right choice depends on your neighborhood, whether it’s residential or commercial, your budget, and whether you need emergency same‑day service. I can find highly rated options near you, but first a few quick, practical points and a couple of well‑known names to consider:

If you want me to look up local companies: tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is an emergency.

General tips for picking the best AC repair company
- Check credentials: verify Texas licensing/registration (TDLR) and proof of insurance.  
- Look for NATE‑certified technicians (industry skill standard).  
- Read recent Google/Yelp/Angie’s List reviews and the BBB rating.  
- Ask about diagnostic fee, parts & labor warranties, and turnaround time.  
- Get at least 2 written estimates (same job scope) before agreeing.  
- Prefer companies that offer emergency/after‑hours service if you need it fast.

Reputable companies that serve Houston (good starting points)
- John Moore Services — long‑established local company with wide service offerings.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter — national firm with many technicians and emergency availability.  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin (franchises) — fast response reputation.

If your AC is down now and you want immediate troubleshooting, tell me what’s happening (no cool air, unit won’t start, blower runs but no cold, strange noises, tripped breaker, etc.) and I’ll walk you through basic checks before you call a technician. Or give your ZIP code and I’ll find top‑rated repair companies in your area with contact info and recent ratings. Which do you prefer?
